name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
scheduleDescription: Scheduled approximately every 15 minutes via GitHub Actions. Actual workflow start may be delayed.
provides: Recorded earthquakes worldwide from the USGS 'all earthquakes, past 7 days' GeoJSON summary feed: magnitude, depth, location, time, tsunami flag and PAGER alert level where supplied.
coverage: Global recorded earthquakes. Completeness is highest in the United States; small earthquakes elsewhere may not be listed.
coverageLimitations: Detection and publication timing vary by region and network. Magnitudes, locations and other parameters can be revised after publication, and some events are deleted.
licenseOrAttribution: Data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS). USGS-authored data is generally in the U.S. public domain; please credit USGS.
